description: Schedule PLANNED exercise(s) on the athlete's STRUGGL training calendar (prefer passing `sessions: [...]` + `debrief_summary` in a single batch call for a full day or multi-day week plan, with `replace: true` when regenerating planned days).

date.description: Target calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (required for single-exercise calls; default date for `sessions`).

debrief_summary.description: Concise coaching summary shown alongside the plan card in the STRUGGL app connector feed.

replace.description: When true, replaces existing planned exercises on the covered date(s) instead of appending.

rpe.description: Session RPE (1–10). When omitted in STRUGGL's stateful ledger, inferred deterministically from the athlete's rolling 30-day e1RM capacity envelope.

sessions.description: Batch of planned exercises (across one or multiple dates) to schedule in one call.

name: plan_workout
